verses.gurmukhi: ਕਲਿ ਆਈ ਕੁਤੇ ਮੁਹੀ ਖਾਜੁ ਹੋਇਆ ਮੁਰਦਾਰ ਗੁਸਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kal aaiee kute muhee khaaj hoiaa muradhaar gusaiee|

en.bdb: O God! in kaliyug , the mentality of the jiv has become like the mouth of dog which always seeks the dead to eat.

verses.gurmukhi: ਰਾਜੇ ਪਾਪੁ ਕਮਾਂਵਦੇ ਉਲਟੀ ਵਾੜ ਖੇਤ ਕਉ ਖਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: raaje paap kamaa(n)vadhe ulaTee vaaR khet kau khaiee|

en.bdb: The kings are sinning as if the protective fence were itself devouring the (crop in the) field.

verses.gurmukhi: ਪਰਜਾ ਅੰਧੀ ਗਿਆਨ ਬਿਨੁ ਕੂੜੁ ਕੁਸਤੁ ਮੁਖਹੁ ਆਲਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: parajaa a(n)dhee giaan bin kooR kusat mukhahu aalaiee|

en.bdb: Bereft of knowledge, the blind people are uttering falsehood.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੇਲੇ ਸਾਜ ਵਜਾਇਦੇ ਨਚਨਿ ਗੁਰੂ ਬਹੁਤੁ ਬਿਧਿ ਭਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chele saaj vajaidhe nachan guroo bahut bidh bhaiee|

en.bdb: Now the gurus are dancing variously to the tunes played by the disciples.

verses.gurmukhi: ਚੇਲੇ ਬੈਠਨਿ ਘਰਾਂ ਵਿਚਿ ਗੁਿਰ ਉਠਿ ਘਰੀਂ ਤਿਨਾੜੇ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: chele baiThan gharaa(n) vich guir uTh gharee(n) tinaaRe jaiee|

en.bdb: The students now sit at home and the teachers go to their abodes

verses.gurmukhi: ਕਾਜੀ ਹੋਏ ਰਿਸਵਤੀ ਵਢੀ ਲੈ ਕੈ ਹਕੁ ਗਵਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: kaajee hoe risavatee vaddee lai kai hak gavaiee|

en.bdb: Qazis enjoy bribes and getting the same they have lost their high regards and position.

verses.gurmukhi: ਇਸਤ੍ਰੀ ਪੁਰਖੈ ਦਾਮਿ ਹਿਤੁ ਭਾਵੈ ਆਇ ਕਿਥਾਊਂ ਜਾਈ।
verses.translit_en: eisatree purakhai dhaam hit bhaavai aai kithaauoo(n) jaiee|

en.bdb: Man and woman love each other for riches, may they come from anywhere.
The sin has become ubiquitous in the whole world.
